label: D1 after a reward when about to choose a2 (not after a rare transition)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), almost only when the reward input is 1 (99.3% of mass), and almost only when the agent then picks a2 at GO (all but 7 of 59000 active steps). In practice that means after a rewarded a2 to S2 common trial, or on the window first trial. It never fires after an a1 choice or a rare transition (3 steps), or at GO/D2. Recall is ~0.98, but precision is only ~0.5: in the same situation it is often silent. The policy logit at D1 being moderately negative (-4.4 to -2, i.e. a mild a2 preference) gives a slightly better F1 (0.72 dev), and value >= 7.73 gives almost no activations. So the unit tracks a reward-driven moderate a2 preference rather than the most confident a2 state. The only FUTURE variable used is action at D1, the agent own upcoming choice, which the agent computes itself. No future random outcome is needed. Activations are small (max 0.006). Magnitude often rises over the first one or two rewarded a2 trials in a window.
